question: Ano ang karagdagang requirements ng OCBO kapag ang itatayong gusali ay may 3 floors pataas?
answer:
For a building with 3 floors or more, the additional requirement from the Office of the City Building Official (OCBO) is the validation of the Occupancy Permit based on the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (2019-2028) for 3-storey buildings and above and building floor area of 1,500 square meters and above. [S1]

The validation of the Locational Clearance issued by the Office of the City Planning & Development Coordinator is also required. [S1]

For the Demolition Permit, the requirements are:
1. Demolition Form with 3 sets of Civil/Architectural Plans of the building duly signed. [S2]

For the building fee computation, refer to the schedule in [S3].

For Division J-2 structures such as garages, carports, balconies, terraces, lanais, and the like, they shall be assessed 50% of the rate of the principal building, of which they are accessories. [S4]

For the Pavement Permit, a requirement is the Pavement Permit form with 3 sets of Civil/Architectural plans. [S5]

ground_truth: For construction, addition, or minor repair of structures that are three (3) storeys and above, OCBO enforces mandatory conditional safety submittals: 1) Construction Safety & Health Program (CSHP) approved by the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) (1 original, 1 photocopy); and 2) Boring and Plate Load Soil Test Report (2 copies) signed and sealed by a licensed Civil/Geotechnical Engineer. If applying for an additional storey, an Affidavit manifesting that the existing foundation can support the proposed additional floors is required.
